findings.en_sentence: The first remains of Spinosaurus were discovered in Egypt in 1912 and formally described by Ernst Stromer in 1915.
findings.es_sentence: Los primeros restos de Spinosaurus fueron descubiertos en Egipto en 1912 y descritos formalmente por Ernst Stromer en 1915.
findings.problem: Calls the 1912 Egyptian material the 'first remains', but the next sentence says Foureau's 1898 Algerian teeth may be the first finds; the source only says the genus was first known from the Egyptian remains.
findings.correct: The genus was first known from Egyptian remains found in 1912 and described by Ernst Stromer in 1915.
findings.checked_in: F003 quote, F013; enwiki Initial finds

findings.en_sentence: The genus Spinosaurus was first described by Ernst Stromer in 1915.
findings.es_sentence: El género Spinosaurus fue descrito por primera vez por Ernst Stromer en 1915.
findings.problem: Repeats what the very next sentence already says (Stromer, 1915).
findings.correct: Merge with the following sentence or drop.

findings.en_sentence: Tail fossils show that Spinosaurus had a keeled tail adapted for swimming.
findings.es_sentence: Los fósiles de la cola muestran que Spinosaurus tenía una cola con quilla adaptada para nadar.
findings.problem: States the swimming adaptation as settled fact, yet the page later says researchers proposed the tail fin was for display and that swimming ability is strongly contested; it was the interpretation of Ibrahim et al. 2020 (2018 fossils).
findings.correct: Tail fossils analysed by Ibrahim and colleagues were interpreted as showing a keeled tail adapted to propel the animal through water.
findings.checked_in: F087 statement/quote, F093, F009; enwiki Swimming; knowledge (Sereno et al. 2022, Hone & Holtz 2021)

findings.en_sentence: During the Cretaceous, North Africa was a mangrove-dominated coastal environment with vast tidal flats and waterways.
findings.es_sentence: Durante el Cretácico, el norte de África era un entorno costero dominado por manglares con vastas marismas de marea y canales de agua.
findings.problem: Source says 'during this period' (the Cenomanian/mid-Cretaceous, when the Tethys bordered the region), not the whole Cretaceous.

findings.en_sentence: The subadult Spinosaurus skeleton was found in the Douira Formation of the Kem Kem Beds in Zrigat, Morocco, dating to the Cenomanian stage of the mid-Cretaceous period.
findings.es_sentence: El esqueleto de un Spinosaurus subadulto fue encontrado en la Formación Douira de los Kem Kem Beds en Zrigat, Marruecos, datado en el piso cenomaniense del periodo Cretácico medio.
findings.problem: Refers to 'the subadult skeleton' (FSAC-KK-11888, the 2014 neotype proposal) that the page never introduced; also 'mid-Cretaceous period' is not a period and clashes with 'Late Cretaceous' in the previous sentence.
findings.correct: A partial subadult skeleton (FSAC-KK-11888), described in 2014, comes from the Douira Formation of the Kem Kem Group at Zrigat, Morocco, of Cenomanian (Late Cretaceous) age.
findings.checked_in: F033; enwiki Initial finds part 2; knowledge (Ibrahim et al. 2014)

findings.en_sentence: Russell distinguished S. maroccanus from S. aegyptiacus by a neck vertebra ratio of 1.5 versus 1.1, but later authors dispute this due to specimen variability and destruction of the holotype.
findings.es_sentence: Russell distinguió a S. maroccanus de S. aegyptiacus mediante una relación de vértebras cervicales de 1,5 frente a 1,1, pero autores posteriores discrepan debido a la variabilidad de los especímenes y la destrucción del holotipo.
findings.problem: Russell and S. maroccanus (a second species named by Dale Russell in 1996) are never introduced; the reader cannot tell what is being distinguished, nor what the ratio measures (centrum length / posterior facet height).
findings.correct: In 1996 Dale Russell named a second species, S. maroccanus, based on a ratio of centrum length to posterior facet height in the neck vertebrae (1.5 vs 1.1 in S. aegyptiacus); later authors doubt it ...
findings.checked_in: F025 quote; enwiki Initial finds part 2

findings.en_sentence: The specimen's body proportions are debated because its hind limbs are disproportionately shorter than in previous reconstructions.
findings.es_sentence: Las proporciones corporales del espécimen son debatidas porque sus extremidades posteriores son desproporcionadamente más cortas que en las reconstrucciones anteriores.
findings.problem: 'The specimen' has no antecedent in its section (the Debate section opens with Russell's species); it means FSAC-KK-11888.
findings.correct: The body proportions of the Moroccan subadult skeleton FSAC-KK-11888 are debated ...

findings.en_sentence: In 2015, Serjoscha Evers and colleagues rejected a neotype proposal for FSAC-KK-11888 due to a lack of locality information, geographical separation from the holotype, and anatomical differences.
findings.es_sentence: En 2015, Serjoscha Evers y sus colegas rechazaron una propuesta de neotipo para FSAC-KK-11888 debido a la falta de información sobre la localidad, la separación geográfica del holotipo y diferencias anatómicas.
findings.problem: FSAC-KK-11888 and the neotype proposal (Ibrahim et al. 2014, replacing the holotype destroyed in 1944) are never introduced, so the specimen number is opaque.
findings.correct: Mention that Ibrahim et al. (2014) proposed the Moroccan subadult skeleton FSAC-KK-11888 as neotype to replace Stromer's destroyed holotype, then Evers et al. 2015 rejected it.
findings.checked_in: F035; enwiki Initial finds part 2/3; knowledge

findings.en_sentence: Researchers suggested Spinosaurus used its large tail fin for display rather than swimming, based on comparisons with living animals.
findings.es_sentence: Los investigadores sugirieron que Spinosaurus usaba su gran aleta de la cola para exhibición en lugar de nadar, basándose en comparaciones con animales vivos.
findings.problem: Source says the fin was 'probably utilized more for display than swimming', not instead of swimming.
findings.correct: ... used its tall tail fin probably more for display than for swimming ...

findings.en_sentence: Fossil evidence suggests Spinosaurus may have preyed on crocodyliforms such as Aegisuchus, found in the Kem Kem Beds.
findings.es_sentence: La evidencia fósil sugiere que Spinosaurus pudo haber depredado crocodiliformes como Aegisuchus, hallado en los Kem Kem Beds.
findings.problem: 'Fossil evidence suggests' is invented; the source only notes in passing that Spinosaurus may have preyed on Aegisuchus, one of several Kem Kem crocodyliforms.
findings.correct: Spinosaurus shared the Kem Kem Beds with crocodyliforms such as Aegisuchus, on which it may have preyed.

findings.en_sentence: A tooth from the Ifezouane Formation attributed to Spinosaurus shows deep grooves and an attenuated carina.
findings.es_sentence: Un diente de la Formación Ifezouane atribuido a Spinosaurus muestra surcos profundos y una carina atenuada.
findings.problem: Source identifies it only as cf. Spinosaurus sp. (tentative), which 'attributed to' overstates.
findings.correct: A tooth from the Ifezouane Formation tentatively referred to Spinosaurus (cf. Spinosaurus sp.) ...

findings.en_sentence: Researchers argue Spinosaurus used its sail to herd fish like a sailfish and its long tail to stun prey like a thresher shark.
findings.problem: Sentence missing from the Spanish paleobiology section.
findings.correct: Los investigadores sostienen que Spinosaurus usaba la vela para acorralar peces como el pez vela y la larga cola para aturdir presas como el tiburón zorro.

findings.en_sentence: Spinosauridae dominated the mid-Cretaceous ecosystems of North Africa alongside Abelisauroidea and Carcharodontosauridae.
findings.problem: Sentence missing from the Spanish time-and-habitat section.
findings.correct: Los Spinosauridae dominaron los ecosistemas del Cretácico medio del norte de África junto a Abelisauroidea y Carcharodontosauridae.

findings.en_sentence: The function of Spinosaurus's sail or hump is uncertain, with hypotheses including heat regulation and display.
findings.problem: Sentence missing in Spanish, so the next ES sentence ('La característica prominente de la espalda...') lacks its lead-in.
findings.correct: La función de la vela o joroba de Spinosaurus es incierta; se ha propuesto la termorregulación y la exhibición, entre otras hipótesis.

findings.en_sentence: Spinosaurus is known to have consumed both aquatic and terrestrial prey.
findings.es_sentence: Spinosaurus se conoce por haber consumido presas tanto acuáticas como terrestres.
findings.problem: Calque of 'is known to have'; in Spanish it means 'is famous for having eaten'.
findings.correct: Se sabe que Spinosaurus consumía presas tanto acuáticas como terrestres.

findings.en_sentence: A juvenile Spinosaurus specimen described in 2018 is estimated to have measured 1.78 meters in length.
findings.es_sentence: Un ejemplar juvenil de Spinosaurus descrito en 2018 se estima que midió 1,78 metros de longitud.
findings.problem: Anacoluthon: subject dangling before 'se estima que'.
findings.correct: Se estima que un ejemplar juvenil de Spinosaurus descrito en 2018 medía 1,78 metros de longitud.

findings.en_sentence: Since its discovery, Spinosaurus has been considered a contender for the largest theropod dinosaur.
findings.es_sentence: Desde su descubrimiento, Spinosaurus ha sido considerado candidato a mayor dinosaurio terópodo.
findings.problem: Missing article / awkward: 'candidato a mayor dinosaurio'.
findings.correct: Desde su descubrimiento, Spinosaurus ha sido considerado candidato a ser el mayor dinosaurio terópodo.

findings.en_sentence: Fossil evidence suggests Spinosaurus may have preyed on crocodyliforms such as Aegisuchus, found in the Kem Kem Beds.
findings.es_sentence: La evidencia fósil sugiere que Spinosaurus pudo haber depredado crocodiliformes como Aegisuchus, hallado en los Kem Kem Beds.
findings.problem: English unit name 'Kem Kem Beds' left untranslated in Spanish text (also in the Douira sentence).
findings.correct: lechos de Kem Kem / Grupo Kem Kem
